C.Brooks,who has been virtually our only senior sprinter this season,gave another solid performance in winning the short sprint. Tony Fairclough proved to be too strong for Mitcham's youth star Badgery,who dropped back after five laps in the 2 miles.

On his first throw he forgot to let go,his second scattered the officials when the weight came off the end,but his third and only legal throw sailed clear over several markers to place him 3rd. 100y 2.C.Ryan 10.3 4.C.Brooks 10.6 'B'1.J.Vivian 10.0

Another to score heavily was Snowy Brooks, although for him this was a rather quiet day as he only took part in six events including the relays.

Snowy Brooks and Arnold Bentt each contributed a handy 15 points as they dashed from one event to another, the former also running in both relays where we gained maximum points, our team in the 4 x 400m being kind enough to give him a 100m lead on the last leg, allowing him a casual circuit in 57 seconds!
Charlie Gillett won the 400 hurdles with a great run, lopping 2 seconds off of his seasonal best and he also managed to pip a tiring Snowy Brooks on the tape in the flat event.

With no second string Pole Vaulter, Glyn Ratcliffe arriving after a long journey too late for the Discus, Snowy Brooks disqualified in the high hurdles for two false starts, Eric Barker three times fouling a winning Hammer throw by just edging out of the circle, the list went on.
